text.edge-graphics.ts: Draws directional graph curves with relation-specific dashes and arrowheads
text.index.ts: Renders the interactive WebGL graph, file or macro, with viewport culling, accessible controls and the pull request marks and the open-file marker on macro blocks, links and outside systems, with the marks calmed and other blocks greyed while a file or a picked flow step's files are open (the marker takes a set of blocks), draws a block a selected platform only uses fainter than a lit one and stronger than a dimmed one, and opens a macro area card or stub on a double tap or Enter without letting a removed focused card re-enter the render. It gives the canvas a tooltip of the block or link under the pointer that follows it, and clears the selection only on a primary-button tap of the background
text.macro-graphics.ts: Draws the macro view's arrows and count labels with strong ones emphasised, only the main links at rest and every link of the selected block, lights the links a pull request touches and quiets the rest, keeps only the links of the blocks being read prominent while a file or a flow step's files are open, and mirrors each arrow as a hidden note for screen readers.
text.node-graphics.ts: Draws file cards, directory tiles and macro blocks with their purpose lines, a quieter look for shared foundation and a glow with changed-of-all files for blocks a pull request touches (a thin outline and the caption only while a file is open), a ringed READING badge on the block of the open file (frame widths from the shared legend list), a dashed edge for a card of features not yet in an area and an open chevron on area cards and stubs, with icons, status marks, PR badges, a quiet related mark, a dashed new look for files a pull request or a plan adds, and open-file buttons, all of which answer a primary-button tap only
text.open-actions.ts: Draws the code and diff buttons on relation-view file tiles and their keyboard-reachable twins, which answer a primary-button tap only
text.palette.ts: Reads graph CSS colors and fonts for Pixi drawing
text.pointer.ts: Tells a primary-button tap on a graph object from a right or middle one
text.relation-graphics.ts: Draws relation-view zones, directory areas that a primary-button tap pins, and focused-file edges
text.text-quality.ts: Defers text-resolution upgrades until graph zoom settles
text.viewport-size.ts: Measures the graph pane by its border box, to notice real resizes, and without rounding a fractional size up, so the canvas never overflows its own scroll area
